originalMovementData.sample: Olea + / DER AN868 (eobs 3644), 2014-08-23..2014-09-04 inclusive. 65,998 eligible published events, 52 exact existing records selected near 00/06/12/18 each published day within three hours; visible TRUE, GPS, eobs status A, valid coordinates. Four selected records/day is an editorial thinning, not the original sensor schedule.
originalMovementData.timeBasis: The original README states UTC or GPS time, with a few leap seconds difference. Display preserves original strings and explicitly does not claim local time or force UTC.
originalMovementData.geographicalScope: Study originates in SW Germany. Displayed actual events include Germany, Switzerland, France and Spain. It is not represented as exclusively within DACH.
originalMovementData.dataVersusContext: One original producer. Other references explain methods and limitations; they do not repeat these measurements.
